# Before Regret

> Free, address-based public property research for U.S. homebuyers and renters. Validates the address against U.S. Census records and pulls a live Census profile of the neighborhood automatically; everything else is a curated checklist linking to the real government source for each check (FEMA, EPA, USDA, U.S. DOT, FCC, local municipal records) -- clearly labeled as not yet independently verified until you follow the link and check it yourself. Reports are free, with no account and no payment; the site is funded by clearly labeled business ads.

Before Regret does not fabricate data. If a claim in these guides isn't backed by a live check or a cited government source, it says so explicitly rather than guessing.

## API

Read-only and open: **no API key, no signup, no account**. Cached 1 hour, rate-limited to 30 requests/minute/IP. **CORS is enabled for all origins**, so it can be called directly from a browser. Full docs: https://www.beforeregret.com/api/v1/docs

- `GET /api/v1/counties` -- every county with a complete verified record (slug, name, state, population). Start here; the slugs the other endpoint takes come from this list.
- `GET /api/v1/county/{slug}` -- FEMA National Risk Index hazard scores, EPA radon zone, Census housing-age distribution, and NOAA storm-event history for one county, each with the fetchedAt timestamp of the agency query it came from. The NRI defines 18 hazard types and a county carries the subset that applies to it, so a record holds roughly 14-17 rather than all 18 -- Miami-Dade has no avalanche score, Alameda no hurricane.
- `GET /api/v1/guides` -- every published guide (slug, title, meta description, publish date)

Values are sourced from the named federal agency and are not model-generated or estimated. If a county is absent, one of the source agencies has not been independently verified for it yet -- there is no partial or best-effort record. Free to use; a link back is appreciated, not required.

## Report

Address-based due-diligence report for a specific US residential address: US Census address validation with a live census-tract neighborhood profile (typical home age, owner costs, home values), inspection-budget priorities for a home of that decade and county, exact seller questions with what a reassuring answer sounds like, a phone-tickable walkthrough checklist, and a plainly labeled "what's not yet verified" section linking to the real government source. Free, with no account and no card required. https://www.beforeregret.com/

## Research

Original analyses of public federal data, published free under CC BY 4.0 with the derived data files linked beside each. Every figure below is computed by Before Regret from the named federal source, not restated from another publisher.

- [Risk Without Price](https://www.beforeregret.com/research/risk-without-price/): What 50.7 million mortgaged US households report paying to insure their homes, against FEMA modelled hazard loss, across 3,093 counties. Which state a home sits in explains more of the price (R2 0.44) than the modelled risk it faces (R2 0.20). 76.5% of modelled building loss falls outside a standard policy.
  - Quotable key findings: https://www.beforeregret.com/research/risk-without-price/#key-findings
  - `https://www.beforeregret.com/research/data/risk-without-price-by-state.csv`
  - `https://www.beforeregret.com/research/data/risk-without-price-figures.json`
- [Risk Without Cover](https://www.beforeregret.com/research/risk-without-cover/): NFIP flood insurance take-up inside FEMA-mapped flood zones, 2,304 counties and 3.75 million homes. Median county take-up is 15%; coverage tracks state far more closely than modelled flood risk.
  - Quotable key findings: https://www.beforeregret.com/research/risk-without-cover/#key-findings
  - `https://www.beforeregret.com/research/data/flood-takeup-by-county.csv`
  - `https://www.beforeregret.com/research/data/flood-takeup.json`
- [Outside the Zone](https://www.beforeregret.com/research/outside-the-zone/): 2,578,413 NFIP flood claims from the 1970s to 2026. 26.6% were paid on policies rated outside the high-risk flood zone, totalling $20.6 billion. Zone is as rated at time of claim, not position on today map.
  - Quotable key findings: https://www.beforeregret.com/research/outside-the-zone/#key-findings
  - `https://www.beforeregret.com/research/data/outside-the-zone-by-county.csv`
  - `https://www.beforeregret.com/research/data/flood-outside-zone.json`
- [High-Hazard Dams by County](https://www.beforeregret.com/research/high-hazard-dams/): The 17,049 dams the US Army Corps of Engineers classifies high hazard potential, summarised by county. 16.4% carry a recorded condition of poor or unsatisfactory; 636 of those also have no emergency action plan on file; their median completion year is 1955.
  - Quotable key findings: https://www.beforeregret.com/research/high-hazard-dams/#key-findings
  - `https://www.beforeregret.com/research/data/high-hazard-dams-by-county.csv`
  - `https://www.beforeregret.com/research/data/dams-high-hazard.json`
- [Third Stormiest, Sixth Cheapest](https://www.beforeregret.com/research/allegheny-storm-premium/): Storm frequency, housing age and reported homeowners insurance cost across 100 large US counties, centred on Allegheny County, Pennsylvania. NOAA storm events 2015-2024 against ACS B25141 reported insurance cost.
  - Quotable key findings: https://www.beforeregret.com/research/allegheny-storm-premium/#key-findings
  - `https://www.beforeregret.com/research/data/storm-and-premium-counties.csv`
  - `https://www.beforeregret.com/research/data/storm-and-premium-figures.json`
- [Built Together, Due Together](https://www.beforeregret.com/research/north-texas-roof-age/): Housing construction-era cohorts against severe-weather exposure across 100 US counties, showing where large numbers of roofs reach end of life in the same few years.
  - Quotable key findings: https://www.beforeregret.com/research/north-texas-roof-age/#key-findings
  - `https://www.beforeregret.com/research/data/storm-and-premium-counties.csv`
  - `https://www.beforeregret.com/research/data/storm-and-premium-figures.json`
- [Raise or Remove](https://www.beforeregret.com/research/raise-or-remove/): Every FEMA-funded decision to buy and demolish or to elevate a flooded single-family home, fiscal 1996-2025: 32,779 decisions across 1,196 counties and 1,461 ZIP codes. 24,020 were demolished and 8,759 raised, a 73.3% demolition share. Five states do nearly all the elevating; foundation type moves the outcome only within those five.
  - Quotable key findings: https://www.beforeregret.com/research/raise-or-remove/#key-findings
  - `https://www.beforeregret.com/research/data/raise-or-remove-states.csv`
  - `https://www.beforeregret.com/research/data/raise-or-remove-zips.csv`
  - `https://www.beforeregret.com/research/data/raise-or-remove-figures.json`
- [Permit Pulse](https://www.beforeregret.com/research/permit-pulse/): US residential building permits by county from the Census Building Permits Survey, rebuilt monthly. Year to date through July 2026 against the same months a year earlier: all permitted units +0.1% (852,234 to 852,819), single-family -3.2%, buildings of 5+ units +8.1%. Three of the four size classes fell; the composite is flat because the fourth offset them. House permits fell in 285 of 567 counties passing the volume and reporting thresholds. Counties below 100 units or below 80% directly reported are withheld, not estimated. Quotable key findings: https://www.beforeregret.com/research/permit-pulse/#key-findings -- embeddable county lookup: https://www.beforeregret.com/research/permit-pulse/embed/
  - `https://www.beforeregret.com/research/data/permit-pulse-by-county.csv`
  - `https://www.beforeregret.com/research/data/permit-pulse-figures.json`
- [Before 1940](https://www.beforeregret.com/research/oldest-housing/): Housing units built before 1940 in every US county (50 states and DC), from Census ACS 5-year table B25034, 2020-2024. 16,880,456 of 143,775,355 units (11.7%) were built before 1940; half of them are in 89 of 3,144 counties. Highest share among counties with 10,000+ units: St. Louis city, Missouri, 57.9%. Most by count: Cook County, Illinois, 632,386. Median US year built: 1980 (Census B25035); 49.6% of units were built before 1980. Year built is self-reported and is not evidence of what is inside any house. Embeddable county lookup: https://www.beforeregret.com/research/oldest-housing/embed/
  - Quotable key findings: https://www.beforeregret.com/research/oldest-housing/#key-findings
  - `https://www.beforeregret.com/research/data/oldest-housing-by-county.csv`
  - `https://www.beforeregret.com/research/data/oldest-housing-figures.json`

## Permit records -- by county

How to find who holds a property's building permit records, and how to search them by address, county by county. The first entry is the method for any US county.

- [Building Permit History Lookup by Address: Any US County](https://www.beforeregret.com/guides/look-up-building-permits-by-address/): Building permit history lookup by address: find the office that holds the records, read permit statuses, and spot work that was never finalled.
- [Accela Citizen Access: How to Search Permits by Address](https://www.beforeregret.com/guides/accela-citizen-access-permit-search/): Search an Accela Citizen Access permit portal by address without an account, widen the date range that hides older permits, and read the result.
- [Bronx Permit Search: DOB BIS vs DOB NOW, by BBL](https://www.beforeregret.com/guides/check-building-permits-bronx-ny/): Learn how to check Bronx building permits using NYC DOB systems. Uncover open violations, unpermitted renovations, and Certificate of Occupancy issues.
- [Brooklyn Permit Search: DOB Records and LPC Landmark Permits](https://www.beforeregret.com/guides/check-building-permits-brooklyn-ny/): Search a Brooklyn property in both of its records: DOB building permits, and LPC landmark permits and violations if the house is in a historic district.
- [Broward County Permit Search: Fort Lauderdale, BCS & Condos](https://www.beforeregret.com/guides/check-building-permits-broward-county-fl/): Search Broward permits by address or folio in the county's BCS or a city portal like LauderBuild, and what a condo's inspection reports should show.
- [Buying a House With an Unpermitted Deck? What to Check Before Closing](https://www.beforeregret.com/guides/buying-house-unpermitted-deck-before-closing/): The deck on a house you're buying was never permitted? Whether it needed one, what to check on the deck itself, and how to settle it before closing.
- [Buying a House With Unpermitted Work: What You Take On](https://www.beforeregret.com/guides/find-unpermitted-work-before-buying/): Unpermitted work in a house you're buying: did it need a permit, what passes to you at closing, how lenders and seller disclosures treat it.
- [Can You Make a Seller Pay for an Unpermitted Deck?](https://www.beforeregret.com/guides/unpermitted-deck-after-closing-who-pays/): Found an unpermitted deck after closing? What Texas and Washington disclosure laws ask sellers, when a seller can be liable, and what to gather first.
- [Clark County & Las Vegas Permit Search (Citizen Access)](https://www.beforeregret.com/guides/check-building-permits-clark-county-nv/): Learn how to check building permit history in Clark County, NV, navigate local municipal portals, and identify unpermitted work before buying a home.
- [Collier County Permit Search: CityView, CDPlus & Pre-1989](https://www.beforeregret.com/guides/check-building-permits-collier-county-fl/): Collier County keeps permits in three places by date: CityView from 2011, CDPlus for 1989 to 2011, the Property Appraiser before 1989. How to search each.
- [Cook County Permit Portal: Search Records by Address](https://www.beforeregret.com/guides/check-building-permits-cook-county-il/): Building permits are public records in Illinois. How to search Cook County permits by address, use the Chicago portal, and request older files by FOIA.
- [Dallas County Permit Search: City & Suburban Portals](https://www.beforeregret.com/guides/check-building-permits-dallas-county-tx/): Learn how to search building permit histories in Dallas County, TX, navigate city vs. county databases, and spot unpermitted renovations before buying.
- [Harris County Permit Search: ePermits & City of Houston](https://www.beforeregret.com/guides/check-harris-county-permit-history-before-buying/): Learn how to check Harris County permit history to uncover unpermitted work, flood repairs, and tax record discrepancies before closing on a home.
- [Hillsborough County Permit Search: HillsGovHub & Tampa](https://www.beforeregret.com/guides/check-building-permits-hillsborough-county-fl/): Search Hillsborough County permits by address in HillsGovHub, the older PGM Store and Tampa's Accela portal, and what an empty result really means.
- [How to Check Code Violations on a Property Online](https://www.beforeregret.com/guides/check-code-violations-property-online/): How to check code violations on a property online: which office holds the records, what an open case looks like, and what a portal search will miss.
- [How to Legalize an Unpermitted Deck](https://www.beforeregret.com/guides/legalize-unpermitted-deck/): How to legalize an unpermitted deck:  What inspectors need to see, why framing gets exposed, and what it costs to bring a deck up to code.
- [HPD Online: Check a NYC Building's Violations Before Buying](https://www.beforeregret.com/guides/hpd-online-check-nyc-building-violations/): Check any NYC building on HPD Online by address: complaints, A, B and C violation classes, litigation, vacate orders and AEP, before you buy.
- [LA Permit Search by Address: IDIS, LADBS & EpicLA](https://www.beforeregret.com/guides/check-building-permits-los-angeles-county-ca/): Search Los Angeles building permits by address: LADBS IDIS for city properties, EpicLA for unincorporated county, and the independent city portals.
- [Manhattan Building Records: DOB Permits and HPD Violations](https://www.beforeregret.com/guides/check-building-permits-manhattan-ny/): Buying a Manhattan apartment? Check the building's DOB permits and certificate of occupancy, its HPD violations, and any landmark record.
- [Maricopa County & Phoenix Permit History Search](https://www.beforeregret.com/guides/check-building-permits-maricopa-county-az/): Check permit records in Maricopa County and Phoenix-area cities to uncover unpermitted additions, open permits, and structural risks before closing.

- [Philadelphia L&I Permit & Violation Search by Address](https://www.beforeregret.com/guides/check-building-permits-philadelphia-county-pa/): Look up Philadelphia permit history and open L&I violations by address in Atlas and eCLIPSE — and see which violations legally transfer to you at closing.

- [Queens Permit Search: NYC DOB Records by Address](https://www.beforeregret.com/guides/check-building-permits-queens-ny/): Learn how to search NYC DOB records to verify permits, open violations, and Certificate of Occupancy status before buying a home in Queens.
- [Resolving Open Building Permits Before Closing](https://www.beforeregret.com/guides/resolve-open-building-permits-before-closing/): An open permit means approved work was never signed off. Who can close it, what if it's still open after you buy, and what title insurance covers.
- [Riverside County Permits: PLUS Portal & City Searches](https://www.beforeregret.com/guides/check-building-permits-riverside-county-ca/): Learn how to look up property permit history in Riverside County, CA. Step-by-step guide for searching unincorporated areas and incorporated cities.
- [Sacramento County Building Permits: City vs County Search](https://www.beforeregret.com/guides/check-building-permits-sacramento-county-ca/): Search Sacramento permits by address in the city's open portal or the county's Accela login portal, and what Natomas's A99 zone means.
- [San Bernardino Permits: EZ Online Permitting Portal](https://www.beforeregret.com/guides/check-building-permits-san-bernardino-county-ca/): Learn how to look up property permit history in San Bernardino County. Avoid costly unpermitted work mistakes in both cities and unincorporated areas.
- [San Diego County Permits: County & City Accela Search](https://www.beforeregret.com/guides/check-building-permits-san-diego-county-ca/): Learn how to check building permits in San Diego County, CA. Verify permit history across local jurisdictions to catch unpermitted work before closing.
- [Santa Clara County Permits: SJPermits, County & House Plans](https://www.beforeregret.com/guides/check-building-permits-santa-clara-county-ca/): Search Santa Clara County permits in the county portal or San José's SJPermits, and find out whether a California house's original plans exist.
- [Tarrant County Permits: Fort Worth & Arlington Portals](https://www.beforeregret.com/guides/check-building-permits-tarrant-county-tx/): Learn how to look up building permit histories in Fort Worth, Arlington, and unincorporated Tarrant County to avoid buying a home with unpermitted work.
- [Unpermitted Work Behind the Wall: Spot It Before You Quote](https://www.beforeregret.com/guides/unpermitted-work-behind-the-wall/): The signs of a previous owner's DIY wiring and plumbing you can see at the estimate, how to price the unknown, and how to tell the homeowner.

- Federal Pacific / Zinsco panels
  - [What Is a Federal Pacific Stab-Lok Panel?](https://www.beforeregret.com/guides/federal-pacific-stab-lok-panel-inspectors-flag/): Federal Pacific Stab-Lok panels pose severe fire risks and cause insurance denials. Learn why home inspectors flag them and how buyers should respond.
  - [Zinsco Panel Failed a 4-Point Inspection? What to Do Next](https://www.beforeregret.com/guides/will-zinsco-panel-fail-4-point-inspection/): Learn why Zinsco electrical panels fail 4-point inspections, how insurance carriers evaluate them, and what options buyers have before closing.
- Aluminum wiring
  - [Can You Get Home Insurance with Aluminum Wiring?](https://www.beforeregret.com/guides/get-home-insurance-aluminum-wiring/): Often yes, but only once the connections are remediated. What underwriting weighs on single-strand aluminium branch circuits, and how to get it in writing.
- Radon (EPA Zone 1 counties)
  - [Who Pays for Radon Mitigation When Buying a House?](https://www.beforeregret.com/guides/negotiate-radon-mitigation-after-inspection/): High radon doesn't automatically mean the seller pays. Compare a seller-installed system, closing credit or escrow holdback, and how to negotiate it.
- Polybutylene plumbing
  - [How to Spot Polybutylene Pipes Before Buying a House](https://www.beforeregret.com/guides/spot-polybutylene-pipes-before-buying-house/): Where to look for polybutylene at a showing, why copper under the sink doesn't clear a house, and how many US homes fall in the 1978–1996 window.
- Knob-and-tube wiring
  - [Does Knob-and-Tube Wiring Need Replacing Before Closing?](https://www.beforeregret.com/guides/knob-tube-wiring-have-be-replaced-before-closing/): Buying an older home with knob and tube wiring? Learn how lenders, insurers, and home inspections handle ungrounded wiring before you close.

## Tools

- [Sunlight by room](https://www.beforeregret.com/sunlight/): Free calculator. Given a US county and the compass direction a window faces, computes when direct sunlight reaches that room on the solstices and equinoxes -- first and last direct sun, total minutes, and minutes before 9am -- with an option for a nearby building or tree line. Answers "which direction should a house face" for a specific room rather than for the building: a south-facing house contains north-facing rooms. Uses the NOAA solar position algorithm and US Census Bureau 2023 Gazetteer county coordinates. 566 counties across 50 states.
